game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the hold guard must hold off snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the watch bell.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the watch bell. Then check vault and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from snow wraiths in Snowdrift Barracks: keep vault above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 3, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
